issues.title: Flat on the bed
issues.message: Nothing on the bottom of this part sits flat on the print bed — it is rounded or tilted. It will need supports and may wobble or detach while printing.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so its largest flat face is on the bottom, or add a flat base before exporting.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 79% of the part's volume (44.8 cm³ of support for 56.9 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: Requires Support
